rows.text: O.N. 8(E) records that the Election Commission, 'by its order dated the 14th January, 1993, in the dispute relating to Janata Dal under paragraph 15 of the Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968', froze the symbol 'Chakra (Wheel)' reserved for the Janata Dal as a recognised National Party and directed that none of the rival or splinter groups would be entitled to use that symbol or the name of the party 'Janata Dal' until further orders.

The same order of 14 January 1993 'also directed that the two groups of the Janata Dal headed by S/Shri Ajit Singh and S. R. Bommai respectively shall be recognised as National parties, as a purely ad hoc and interim arrangement and until further orders'.

By a further order the Commission directed that the group headed by Shri Ajit Singh be recognised under the name 'Janata Dal (A)' with the symbol 'Inkpot and Pen', and the group headed by Shri S. R. Bommai under the name 'Janata Dal (B)' with the symbol 'Cup and Saucer'; the English text dates that order 'the 17th January, 1993' and the Hindi text 16 January 1993.

locator.section: English notification O.N. 8(E), third recital (clauses (i)-(iv)); Hindi text on PDF page 1

rows.text: O.N. 8(E) of 17 January 1993 substitutes in Table I of notification No. 56/92 of 7 January 1993 the entry '5. Janata Dal Chakra (Wheel) 7, Jantar Mantar Road New Delhi-110001', with the note '(Dispute relating to Janata Dal pending before the Election Commission; symbol 'Chakra (Wheel)' not to be allotted to any candidate, until further orders of the Commission)', and adds entries 5A 'Janata Dal (A)' and 5B 'Janata Dal (B)'.
